summary: Stridhan ownership; father's locus standi to claim daughter's stridhan; delay in complaint; absolute ownership of stridhan established; husband/father lacking rights over stridhan; divorce finality via mutual consent; complainant's locus invalid due to daughter's exclusive ownership; criminal proceedings improper due to laches and daughter's settlement.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order refusing to quash proceedings reversed; criminal proceedings quashed due to complainant's lack of locus standi over daughter's stridhan.
